measurements.limitations: Nonexclusive host, external downstream jobs; no repeated variance estimate. Direct LH executes dense Full then masks, default executes selected Full. Equal task projections are distinct from complete records/root connectivity. Full-scale independent equivalence not certified by timing.

static_audit.scope: Read-only committed-source review. No new profile, timing, native build or device qualification. Uncommitted C++ preparation work after this revision is excluded.

findings.finding: Read/Full arithmetic is genuinely G x B x Q/K; shared parameters keep I x O, distinct owners use G x I x O. Short/long qry reuse one QK. This resolves the previous per-node arithmetic graph and repeated QK inside eligible groups.

Intermediate ownership is still per-node. Python compact writes publish 4G fields; Read publishes FG (F=4 ind, F=6 att with regional evidence); Full publishes G. Each is index_select, followed by downstream pack. These are source operation counts for one eligible multi-node group, not measured kernel totals.

Writes reassemble each bank with cat/index_select and optional terminal trimming. Read and selected Full each repack raw bank roles and query layouts. Python constructs G B Q K int64 age and visibility on CPU then transfers both; native constructs those on the payload device. The direct anchor retains a region bank and broadcasts aligned Q K ages.

At this revision C++ writes still group by exact positive row count, normalize per node, call four linear_blocks, and split intermediate outputs; Python FP32/FP64 writes use one tensor formula. Later uncommitted changes are not covered.

Source transforms already reuse exact inputs and ordered roles; complete Aggregate reuse requires identical ordered payload/parameter roots. Each unique receiver still aligns each physical source, stacks fan-in tensors and reduces separately. Source helper stacks A/B before detecting shared matrices. Direct anchor retains source-owner blocks and applies two region incidence contractions.

Actual candidate incidence is rebuilt on CPU over node-row occurrences and grouped by real cardinality; descriptors are stacked or gathered from per-node publications; controls are unpacked per node. Ragged training adds branch-specific root transposes and support-to-CPU. Group count is bounded by candidate cardinalities, not necessarily by B L; required support semantics do not require this storage form.

mixed-a/b/c do not force copies when device and dtype already match. Nevertheless all follow separate Read/control/selection interfaces. mixed-a Read copies per node, so genuinely shared read parameters become independent temporary copies and lose shared-GEMM identity. mixed-b moves selection fields individually, including aliased low/high twice. mixed-c still has host support/finite checks, but no required float D2H boundary.

Default window entry calls the public column executor then eagerly exports B x node terminal State records; next continuation import concatenates them again. Native Python adapter also rebuilds per-node/edge int64 metadata. This is additional to public execution; direct anchor keeps region bank state.

successor.design: Carry typed raw bank, current content, descriptors, allocation controls and actual message support as group tensors plus int64 incidence/owner maps through Aggregate -> writes -> Read -> region -> selected Full. Build source incidence once per topology, adapt actual support without per-event tensor roots. Publish per-node/port/checkpoint projections only on requested observation or serialization boundaries. Internal VJP carries explicit structural support to retain None/zero and aliases. Actual cross-device transfer creates a transport boundary; same-device placement does not.
successor.guardrails: Keep complete candidate sets, physical edge multiplicity, raw int64 logical time, exact checkpoint state and selected-only Full semantics. Do not promote dense Full+mask anchor into complete public semantics. Maintain explicit fallback for unsupported modules and PDG feedback. Independent direct anchor has a narrower projection and a distinct O(N^2) quadratic solver, so no exact global optimality or speed guarantee.
successor.finite_validation: One FC16 and one LH176 direct/public/default comparison after formula/root/restore checks. Count data movement, source/incidence assembly, private/outer graph nodes and actual selected Full work separately. Static improvement is not a timing claim.

reproduction_plan.question: Does the actual grouped numerical boundary reduce FC16/LH176 direct-to-default cost without breaking mathematical roots or exact lifecycle?
reproduction_plan.selection: LH all levels/modes; FC direct/default-native/default-python all modes, public-native training; reuse unchanged Transformer reference with its original source identity.
reproduction_plan.process_policy: one reset warmup + one measured step per configuration, each in a fresh bounded process; profile separately, no Cartesian sweep
reproduction_plan.timing: use existing benchmark complete wall/task boundaries, include necessary input/packing/backward/checks/optimizer/synchronization; construction separately

resources.shared_scope: current conversation only; explicit admission if needed

reproduction_plan.stop: Nonfinite, solver, communication or capacity errors fail the point; no automatic algorithm/device replacement or retry. Dependent resident checks stop on first component failure; unrelated host checks continue.
reproduction_plan.correctness: independent formulas/roots at small sizes, complete directed general-port checks and installed 3-step AdamW/new-process restore; costs alone do not qualify full-scale equality
reproduction_plan.numeric: retain strict FP32 mismatch with bounded same-material FP64/connectivity diagnosis; no relaxed passing thresholds

evaluation.test_policy: sealed; separate frozen finalist review only
